maya.r: Heads-up — Cobalt Health dedicated rollout planned TOMORROW 03:00-05:00 UTC. Need final thumbs-up on pinned model (redwood:model v2.1.3-quant) and rollback thresholds. Customer expects minimal disruption.
liam.c: I reviewed autoscale & reserved slices. 2 GPUs dedicated per slice, burst +1 slice available if queue > 250. Should keep p95 latency under 250ms with the quant build.
priya.s: Checklist: smoke tests, tracing hooks, cost-tagging, and notification templates. I'll own smoke tests. Can we pin the model across the pool during the window?
maya.r: Yes — pin to v2.1.3-quant for cutover. Will enable auto-fallback to v2.1.2 if error rate > 4% or p95 latency spikes > 350ms for 3 consecutive 1m windows.
deploy-bot: Deploy job created: job_id=rb-202803-CH-77, scheduled_at=1803560400, target=dedicated/cobalt-health/pool-a, image=serve:v2.1.3-quant
ben_k: Runbook snippet for rollback (add to ops runbook):
```
# rollback command (CLI)
redwood rollout abort --tenant cobalt-health --job rb-202803-CH-77
redwood model pin --tenant cobalt-health --model v2.1.2 --force
# verify
redwood healthcheck --tenant cobalt-health --route main
```
Also ensure we have last-30m traces exported to the console for quick triage.
alicia_cs: Cobalt Health's PM is on standby during the window and will escalate at any sign of user impact. They've asked for a short customer-facing note if we expect >5m of degraded performance.
liam.c: Confirming autoscaling policy is good. I'll add an aggressive KV-cache pre-warm job 15m before cutover to reduce cold-start token cost.
priya.s: Smoke tests I will run (order): 1) inference cURL sample 2) long-conversation stability 3) embeddings sanity 4) latency p95 check. If any fail, we abort. Timeline: smoke tests start t-20m.
maya.r: Rollback thresholds reiterated: abort if error rate >4% sustained for 3m OR p95 >350ms for 3 sequential 1m buckets OR customer reports severe UX break. If abort: runbook above + notify #incidents + alicia.
deploy-bot: Reminder: canary slice = 5% traffic for 10m, then 25% for 10m, then 100% if no alerts. Canary will auto-fail on thresholds.
ben_k: Monitoring hooks: add a quicktrace dashboard and an alert that tags tenant=cobalt-health. Pager config temporarily escalates to oncall -> liam.c -> maya.r.
maya.r: Final: I'm +1 for the window and pins as stated. @liam.c please kick the job tomorrow at 02:55 UTC to start pre-warm/smoke. Everyone else, please ack if you see any gaps. :thumbsup:
